attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "This reverts a bugfix that restricted drag-and-drop of widgets between Bag/Flow parts to compatible content types, reintroducing the original bug (13068) allowing widgets to be dropped into containers that don't permit their content type, which is a frontend admin-editor behavioral regression but not a data-integrity or breaking API change."}

reason: This reverts a bugfix that restricted drag-and-drop of widgets between Bag/Flow parts to compatible content types, reintroducing the original bug (13068) allowing widgets to be dropped into containers that don't permit their content type, which is a frontend admin-editor behavioral regression but not a data-integrity or breaking API change.
